items.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
items.summary: CyberArena is a dynamic adversarial benchmark that evaluates AI agents through concurrent multi-round attack-and-defense combat in evolving environments, measuring capabilities via a dynamical scoring model.

items.title: Beyond Maliciousness: Static and Runtime Attack-Surface Profiling of Agent Skills
items.summary: Agent skills are Markdown documents that a tool-using agent reads as instructions and then acts on with the privileges of the session that loaded them. Installing one grants authority (the standing to direct the agent, not new privilege), and the size of that grant is what we measure. We present a two-phase attack-surface profiling methodology that combines whole-bundle static analysis and dependency provenance checking with instrumented sandbox execution and separate model-based assessment of the resulting traces. We apply the methodology to 6,309 listings from two marketplaces, selecting listings for execution without conditioning that decision on a prior threat or risk signal. Half the corpus carries evidence of shell-execution capability; the corresponding shares are 35% for filesystem read, 31% each for filesystem write and network egress, and 13% for credential access; seven listings in ten carry at least one elevated capability. That is the surface a user accepts at install time, and almost none of it is visible then. A permission model exists but is close to inert. Authors may list the tools a skill pre-approves in its own frontmatter, which removes confirmation prompts rather than restricting what the skill can reach; of the 6,061 listings whose frontmatter parses, 770 declare anything at all, the vocabulary cannot express credential or environment access, and nothing checks what it does express against the bundle. Declaring is also not declaring accurately: 59% of declaring listings understate what their bundle can do. ClawHub declares roughly twice as often as skillsmp, yet under-declares on 88% of its declarations against 31%. Triage at the marketplace boundary therefore cannot rest on what a listing declares. It must rest on what the bundle can do. These results position capability-oriented attack-surface profiling as a necessary complement to maliciousness detection.

items.title: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
items.summary: Autoregressive transformers retain prompt influence via a power-law decay driven by attention dilution and relay mechanisms, with trained models forgetting faster than untrained ones.

items.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
items.summary: MemT-1.0 introduces a memory-native architecture that embeds continuous memory into foundation model computation, improving long-context efficiency and agentic task performance.

items.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
items.summary: Physical recursive self-improvement in vision-language agents is evaluated via multi-axis metrics, scaling analysis, and workspace interventions to assess improvement speed, limits, and reusable experience.

items.title: Evidence-First Agentic Verification
items.summary: Sauron is an evidence-first agentic verifier that independently validates claims against environment state and execution traces to improve rubric-based evaluation accuracy and reduce reinforcement-learning reward errors.

items.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
items.summary: MemPilot uses reinforcement learning to dynamically curate multimodal agent memory, balancing performance, cost, and latency through adaptive retrieval and model selection.

items.title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
items.summary: AdaExploreBench evaluates whether LLM agents can actively discover hidden environmental rules and adapt to unannounced changes, revealing that current models struggle to seek relevant evidence and detect stale knowledge.

items.title: Interlock: From Local Correctness to Task Completion in Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Interlock synthesizes long-horizon tasks as typed completion graphs to enforce cross-component constraints, then uses agent-based verification and self-training to improve agent performance on complex benchmarks.

items.title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
items.summary: CoworkEnv synthesizes executable training environments for AI coworkers using workflow-guided task construction and programmatic validation, enabling supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning of compact PocketWorker models that improve multi-turn coordination and tool use.

items.title: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
items.summary: TokenWorth is a lightweight online memory framework that learns which past experiences are worth retaining and reusing under tight resource constraints, improving lifelong agent success while reducing token usage.

items.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
items.summary: HarnessPro evolves AI agent harnesses without labels to boost task success and lower execution costs, yielding lightweight, balanced, and high-performance variants via trajectory diagnosis and weighted selection.

items.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
items.summary: CoPE improves agentic reinforcement learning by training policies to generate multi-step action sequences from trajectory histories, increasing sample efficiency without inference overhead.

items.title: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
items.summary: Conditional Program compresses language-model embedding tables by reconstructing only requested rows via shared codes and local scales, reducing storage by 75% while improving fidelity.

items.title: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
items.summary: BlenderWorld is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal language models on realistic 3D creation tasks using rendered outputs and binary rubrics, revealing significant gaps in spatial coherence.

items.title: HSPR: Recovering Software-Agent Benchmark Scores via Hierarchical Posterior Inference
items.summary: Hierarchical Score Posterior Recovery improves agent evaluation efficiency by combining historical response patterns with adaptive task selection to estimate full benchmark scores from small subsets.

items.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
items.summary: OpenVLHarness improves multimodal reasoning by integrating persistent memory, heterogeneous tool interfaces, and iterative evidence composition across 22 benchmarks.

items.title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
items.summary: RSIFlow is a recursive self-improvement framework that dynamically selects component-specific workflows based on execution feedback and evolves a meta-agent to refine orchestration and skills.

items.title: Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation
items.summary: Evaluation readout choices for vision-language models on the POPE benchmark cause large F1 shifts, revealing that unreported token lookup protocols and quantization confound reported hallucination-mitigation gains.

items.title: RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work
items.summary: Researchers benchmark vision-language models on simulated physical work tasks, finding strengths in text-based documentation but weaknesses in measurement reading, spatial reasoning, and acceptability judgment.

items.title: RoboValue: A Fine-Grained Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Unified Evaluation of Robotic Value Models
items.summary: RoboValue introduces a benchmark to evaluate robotic value models across task-state understanding, progress tracking, failure recovery, and consistency in both simulated and real-world settings.

items.title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
items.summary: MARS enables multimodal safety steering using only text-derived refusal directions, avoiding the need for multimodal safety data.

items.title: Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On
items.summary: Guardrail benchmark scores primarily reflect labeling policy rather than detection ability, with minor parameter changes shifting results across full ranges and training contamination undermining reported safety metrics.

items.title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: Researchers identify state hallucination in vision-language-action models and propose sparse feature unlearning to reduce failure behaviors while preserving manipulation skills.

items.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
items.summary: Robots share execution experience across fleets to improve policies via failure-guided retrieval and asynchronous training, achieving high success without extra expert corrections.

items.title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
items.summary: Hybrid language models suffer from competing learning between recurrence and attention layers, and a staged training procedure improves retrieval and overall performance.

items.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
items.summary: ScaleNav learns goal-directed visual dynamics from internet egocentric videos to generate robot actions for language-conditioned local navigation, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-world deployment.

items.title: ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models
items.summary: ActionRoPE encodes action-driven camera motion into world-coordinate rotary positions for consistent spatial control, paired with coordinate-conditioned noise scheduling to stabilize observed regions before generating new content.

items.title: ECHO: Efficient Causal Self-Recursion Beyond Auxiliary Multi-Token Prediction
items.summary: ECHO integrates multi-horizon prediction into the backbone via self-recursion and dynamic depth sampling, improving pretraining efficiency and inference drafting without auxiliary modules.

items.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
items.summary: KronLSTM introduces a Kronecker Delta Rule for stable associative memory updates in linear attention, improving long-context modeling without extra normalization.

items.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
items.summary: Halcyon demonstrates that strong text-to-image generation can be achieved by training multimodal autoregressive models from scratch on image-text pairs without relying on large-scale language pretraining.

items.title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
items.summary: LIBERO-Industry introduces a benchmark translating industrial manufacturing constraints into controllable robot learning tasks to evaluate generalist policies under realistic production conditions.

items.title: HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: HandsOn is a cross-embodiment simulation benchmark and platform for dexterous manipulation that evaluates generalization across robotic arms, hands, objects, and composed tasks, revealing substantial gaps in current multi-task policies and foundation-model-based control.

items.title: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: VLDA reformulates robotic control as compact transition modeling via a Delta variable that bridges vision-language understanding and action generation, improving long-horizon consistency and generalization.

items.title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
items.summary: AffordanceWAM uses affordance representations from human videos to jointly predict future scenes and robot actions, improving manipulation transfer without human action labels.

items.title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
items.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with low-rank adapters enables efficient adaptation of very large multimodal backbones for brain encoding, improving performance and interpretability while reducing computational cost.

items.title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
items.summary: A framework called Stateful Harness separates rule-based world state updates from frozen video rendering to improve consistency in interactive world models with hidden state, evaluated via the WorldState-Bench benchmark.

items.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
items.summary: Researchers introduce AnyGoal to evaluate whether world models can generalize dynamics to unseen combinations of familiar states and actions for planning.

items.title: SPARC: Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus
items.summary: Transcribed speech retains speaker and demographic information that large language models can exploit for verification, though releasing only brief text excerpts reduces linkage risk.

items.title: UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling
items.summary: UniAVC trains separate audio and video branches on abundant unimodal data before aligning them with scarce paired data, using independent noise schedules and asymmetric supervision to enable joint synthesis, cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing.

items.title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
items.summary: SpecMRL improves compressed embeddings by reorganizing features via a learned spectral basis that prioritizes informative directions, outperforming standard MRL at reduced dimensions.

items.title: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
items.summary: Manga2Animate uses paired creator and reviewer agents to build script and storyboard representations from manga panels, yielding more faithful and consistent animations.

items.title: Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
items.summary: DScout improves speculative decoding throughput by aligning diffusion drafter training and inference with prefix acceptance and latency trade-offs.

items.title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
items.summary: EgoXperience introduces a unified framework for joint reconstruction of camera motion, scene geometry, hands, and objects from egocentric video using automatically annotated large-scale data and a single-pass model.

items.title: Think Visually Across Space and Time: Grounded Reasoning for Video Segmentation
items.summary: TCoVP introduces a spatiotemporally grounded video reasoning chain that links entities to timestamped visual evidence for segmentation, improving reasoning and mask prediction across benchmarks.

items.title: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
items.summary: FineSplat improves feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting by using fine-grained patches, dual grouping for efficient multi-view interaction, rendering-based feedback, and compact Gaussian generation to recover richer geometry and appearance efficiently.

items.title: Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
items.summary: HOLI-WORLD is an integrated ecosystem that automates the construction of large-scale learning resources from egocentric recordings to improve machine understanding of dynamic scenes and interactions.

items.title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
items.summary: InfiniDream is a vision-language model framework that generates open-ended, editable, photorealistic 3D worlds through symbolic procedural asset creation and deterministic scene placement.

items.title: QD-Rec: Open-Ended Evolution of Recommendations via Quality-Diversity
items.summary: QD-Rec uses quality-diversity optimization and foundation models to generate diverse, well-reasoned recommendations for high-stakes decision-making.

items.title: DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal
items.summary: DeOverlay uses source-anchored flow matching and visibility-normalized temporal aggregation to remove video overlays while preserving scene structure, and introduces DVTE-Bench for standardized evaluation.
